prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic sapphire-themed beauty close-up with crystal makeup and a feathered couture collar.

prompt.technical_specs: ARRI Alexa 65 look with anamorphic lens character, 8K detail, realistic skin texture, crisp cosmetic crystals, cinematic shallow depth of field, no text or logos.
